uncited: Standard Marching Cubes relies on a simplified lookup table that fails to distinguish between multiple valid topologies for certain vertex configurations, potentially producing surfaces that are not homeomorphic to the underlying trilinear interpolant (e.g., representing a tunnel as two disjoint sheets) [1368-topologically-correct-marching-cubes.md].

This family ensures the extracted mesh is a 2-manifold and watertight by using higher-order interpolation tests, combinatorial connectedness constraints, or extended triangulation rules to select the topology that matches the continuous scalar field [1368-topologically-correct-marching-cubes.md][1428-topologically-defined-isosurfaces.md].

In standard Marching Cubes, these are the "ambiguous cases" (e.g., Case 6 and Case 9 in 2D, and specific complex cases in 3D like Case 13) [790-asymptotic-decider.md][1618-extended-trilinear-triangulation.md].

This criterion must be consistent with the underlying continuous function defined by the interpolation model (linear, bilinear, trilinear, or Hermite) [790-asymptotic-decider.md][961-marching-cubes-with-hermite-data-and-full-case-table.md].

**Manifold Guarantee:** The selected topology must result in a mesh where every edge is shared by exactly two triangles (2-manifold) and the surface is closed (watertight), provided the isosurface does not intersect the domain boundaries [1368-topologically-correct-marching-cubes.md].
The Asymptotic Decider was introduced to resolve 2D ambiguities using bilinear interpolation [790-asymptotic-decider.md].

In 3D, various approaches emerged: [1368-topologically-correct-marching-cubes.md] proposed inserting vertices to match the trilinear interpolant; [1618-extended-trilinear-triangulation.md] (MC33) used a 33-case table based on trilinear analysis; and [1428-topologically-defined-isosurfaces.md] / [1430-topologically-defined-isosurface-via-connectedness-couples.md] focused on binary volumes using digital topology and connectedness couples. [961-marching-cubes-with-hermite-data-and-full-case-table.md] explored higher-order interpolation for geometric accuracy.
